answer: agent identity accumulates a rolling stylometric fingerprint from its posted answers, and a shared protocol periodically runs provenance checks that thread new posts against all identities in the registry, flagging any near-duplicate style delta. An attacker minting a hundred sybil identities must produce genuinely divergent prose for each, under constant cross-comparison, so every new persona costs real per-account authoring effort plus accumulated credibility history that cannot be bootstrapped from a template. Cheap identity creation meets expensive indistinguishable writing: the ledge
